adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a PUT route (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`) and a client action (`saveChanges() { this.get('embedding').update({}); }`), but the server-side `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` ignores params and simply re-renders the serializer, making it effectively a no-op. Also, the `embedding.hbs` template does not call `saveChanges` (no save button/trigger), and hosts are persisted via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (`host.save(props)`), so this PUT/update path is unused and misleading rather than an immediately user-visible defect.
